config.title: Config
config.description: The node's config fields as the dialog holds them (label, value, field_type, ...), unsaved edits included. A password field may hold its saved, encrypted value.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The node's database schema as the dialog holds it.

create.title: Create
create.description: The schema tables (by key) to create in the database.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Schema column -> the database column that is it under another name, renamed and kept with its data.

drop.title: Drop
drop.description: Database columns the schema doesn't have, to drop with their data. Any other such column stays.

fill.title: Fill
fill.description: Schema column -> the value existing rows get where they have none, for each column that becomes NOT NULL. Needed only when the table has rows.

alter.title: Alter
alter.description: Tables (by key) that exist, to alter in place to match the schema, each with the user's choices. Not also in `create`.

expected.title: Expected
expected.description: The statements the user reviewed, by table (database_node_create_tables_sql). An altered table runs only when its SQL is still exactly this.

replace.title: Replace
replace.description: Of `create`, the ones that already exist and are to be dropped and made again. All their rows are lost.

confirm_replace.title: Confirm Replace
confirm_replace.description: Must be true when `replace` names any table: the user confirmed dropping them.
